title: Layer 1: Hormuz Direct Indicators

desc: Core variables driving the entire chain
desc_zh: 所有逻辑链的第一推动力

warRiskPremium.note: Ships face ~4,000× higher insurance costs. 'Strait of Hormuz reopens: But can ships safety be assured?' (Al Jazeera, Jun 19). Premium stable at elevated levels — market cautious despite ceasefire MOU. Updated 2026-06-21
warRiskPremium.note_zh: 船只保费飙升约4000倍。'霍尔木兹海峡重开：但航行安全能保证吗？'溢价高位企稳——市场对停火MOU持谨慎态度。更新于 2026-06-21

straitThroughput.note: Ceasefire MOU signed Jun 17 — strait briefly reopened. Iran re-closed Jun 20 citing 'clear breach' of commitments. CENTCOM denies closure, insists traffic flowing. 'Shipping companies will decide when Hormuz is open' (Fortune, Jun 21). Trump threatens US tolls if no final deal in 60 days. Oil at 3-month low (Reuters, Jun 15). US-Iran talks in Switzerland Jun 21. Updated 2026-06-21
straitThroughput.note_zh: 6月17日签署停火MOU——海峡短暂重开。伊朗6月20日以'明确违反承诺'为由再次关闭。CENTCOM否认关闭，坚称通航正常。'航运公司将决定海峡何时开放'。特朗普威胁若60天内无最终协议则征收美方通行费。油价跌至3个月低点。美伊谈判6月21日在瑞士进行。更新于 2026-06-21

irgcStatementFreq.note: Ceasefire MOU signed Jun 17, then Iran re-closed strait Jun 20 citing US violations. IRGC military command issued closure statement. US-Iran talks Jun 21 in Switzerland. MOU text published (NYT, Jun 21). Escalation ladder: MOU >> breach claim >> re-closure >> negotiations. Updated 2026-06-21
irgcStatementFreq.note_zh: 6月17日签署停火MOU，6月20日伊朗以美方违约为由再次关闭海峡。IRGC军事指挥部发布关闭声明。美伊6月21日在瑞士谈判。MOU文本已公布（纽约时报）。升级阶梯：MOU>>违约声明>>再次关闭>>谈判。更新于 2026-06-21

fleetPosition.value: At anchor — Bahrain | CENTCOM denial of closure
fleetPosition.value_zh: 锚泊中——巴林 | CENTCOM否认关闭
fleetPosition.note: Naval blockade of Iran lifted per ceasefire MOU terms. CENTCOM strait denial vs Iran re-closure claim. US-Iran talks Sunday in Switzerland with Vance. Updated 2026-06-21
fleetPosition.note_zh: 根据停火MOU条款解除对伊朗海上封锁。CENTCOM否认关闭vs伊朗声称重新关闭。万斯赴瑞士参加美伊谈判（6月21日）。更新于 2026-06-21

saudiUaeStance.value_zh: 向美施压，探索替代方案
saudiUaeStance.threshold_zh: 自行其是 = 同盟裂痕
saudiUaeStance.note: MBS declined Evian G7 meeting with France (Jun 12). Trump calls MBS a 'warrior'. Saudi plays central role in Hormuz recovery. OPEC+ 4th quota hike. G7 summit (Jun 16-17) discussed Hormuz tolls. Trump-MBS relationship remains key to GCC cohesion. Updated 2026-06-21
saudiUaeStance.note_zh: MBS拒绝与法国在埃维昂会晤（6月12日）。特朗普称MBS为'战士'。沙特在霍尔木兹恢复中发挥核心作用。OPEC+第四次增产。G7峰会讨论海峡通行费。特朗普-MBS关系仍是GCC凝聚力关键。更新于 2026-06-21
